mandatory_sections.name: Scope and System Overview
mandatory_sections.description: High-level description of system purpose, operational scope, and subsystem boundaries.

mandatory_sections.name: Functional Requirements
mandatory_sections.description: Functional capabilities, actions, transformations, and system behavioral requirements.

mandatory_sections.name: Interface Requirements
mandatory_sections.description: Hardware, software, bus, communications protocol, and user interface specifications.

mandatory_sections.name: Safety and Failure Handling
mandatory_sections.description: Fault detection, exception handling, containment modes, and fail-safe recovery procedures.

rules.name: Unique Requirement ID
rules.description: Every requirement must have a unique identifier (e.g., REQ-001).

rules.name: Clear Behaviour
rules.description: The requirement must describe what the system shall do using clear binding normative language.

rules.name: Measurable Criteria
rules.description: The requirement should contain measurable/verifiable criteria where applicable.

rules.name: Avoid Vague Language
rules.description: Detect vague words that introduce ambiguity into specifications.
